g.text: Turbidimeter · upper PCB matched to routed base
Common KiCad coordinates · same scale · dashed circle: 44 mm enclosure
Physical UP = B: THT + wire heads · SOLDER SIDE = F: SMD + upper sockets

Base J2: 1 D− / 2 D+ / 3 VBUS / 4 GND · Upper J5: 1 VBUS / 2 GND / 3 D− / 4 D+

Upper rev. 0.10 · 13 October 2026 · base as supplied / provisional fit
